name: Thistle Meridian Response Agreement
text:
Thistle Meridian Response Agreement
Thistle Meridian provides Packet Orchard on the Amber plan from 2037-01-01 through 2037-12-31. Availability is measured over each UTC calendar month as 100 multiplied by (1 minus unavailable minutes divided by all minutes in the month).
For availability below 99.4%, the customer receives a future invoice credit equal to 13% of its lost gross profit attributable to the outage. Lost gross profit must be determined by an independent accountant using the customer's contemporaneous sales and avoidable-cost records; it is not the subscription fee.
Claims must be received within 26 calendar days after the affected month ends.
